comparison.objective: Depin one connector terminal vs open a panel held by a spring plunger.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade insertion beneath an internal tab plus wire/tool withdrawal vs pulling an external plunger while swinging a hinged panel clear.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone vs panel reaches the required opening without cabinet or latch damage.
comparison.reason: Both release latches, but the actual tested coordination and resulting motion are different.
